title: Indentation-plateau mechanism: far field vs vertical near field vs model bias

gates.quantity: |e_delta(dz=a/6) - e_delta(dz=a/24)| (pct points), radial near field bit-identical
gates.reference: a genuinely mesh-independent model bias would leave e_delta unchanged (0 pp); a discretisation artefact of the unrefined vertical spacing must move it
gates.note: the h/a ladder refined r only and never dz, so 'mesh independent' was a one-directional statement; this gate makes the dz axis part of the record

gates.quantity: shift (pp) of |e_delta| when the stretched far field is refined from 16 to 64 vertical (26 -> 104 radial) layers
gates.reference: H_far predicted a collapse of the offset; the pre-declared equivalence band is 0.05 pp
gates.note: passing this gate means 'the far field is NOT the mechanism', i.e. H_far is rejected; the extrapolated limit only moves -0.4278 -> -0.3878 %

gates.quantity: |e_delta| at dz=a/48, depth 768a (case-pool metric, vertical-refined near field)

gates.reference: p0 = 3P/(2 pi a^2); the 5% band of the case certificate does not apply to this refined model, 0.05% is the pre-declared study bound

recorded_targets.quantity: Richardson limit of |e_delta| as depth -> inf at dz=a/24
